cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Told You Enough
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll be honest about my birthday. When you rang, I was eating dinner alone. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother posted a photo from our kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. He came for dessert. By dinner, I mean the main course.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's beside you while you're carving the chicken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carving isn't eating. I meant the moments when food was actually in my mouth.

mechanism: A directs a birthday explanation and accepts B photographic evidence while redefining dinner and eating to preserve a claim of honesty.
confusable: Unlike a simple false denial, A incorporates each concrete fact but narrows the unit in which honesty is measured.
comparison: Photo evidence about a meal differs from location definitions around a donation box.
seedUse: D143-b brother photograph, dessert and carving; S02-b accepts B chosen evidence while controlling its interpretation.
